_about: Who is stronger. Ctrl+Alt+Shift+K starts the newest skit file, Ctrl+Alt+Shift+X aborts. She starts hidden and wakes on Hey Irene. His turns end after 1.2 s of quiet - except the Jarvis question (beat 4), which gets 2.5 s: her full intro (boot, summon song, the domain expansion) plays to the end before her first line. Beat 5 she answers thinking it over (the thinking face, a finger at her chin) - no attitude yet - and the 800 ms after it is the setup. Beat 7 fires her domain expansion on the line, exactly as the summon draws it (visor in, lifted off one eye, ice-blue, the black hole behind), held 3 s after the eye ignites; the sound (domain_win: the summon's riser and swell, the impact on the eye) leads her words by 850 ms so 'Nah.' lands on the impact. Every key is explained in core/irene/skit.py.

beats.line: If Jarvis used at 100% its power, he might give me some trouble.
